name: pintag-agent-assignment-tests
description: Regression coverage for a reported bug: editing a listing caused its Agent (managed_by_party_id) to appear unselected. Root cause: editListing() set #f-agent-id's value before showForm()'s loadAgentsForDropdown() fetch (unawaited) had populated the dropdown's <option>s -- setting a <select>'s value to an id with no matching <option> yet silently resets it to "", and the value was never reapplied once the real options arrived. A second, related bug: the save payload derived managed_by_party_id by re-looking up the selected id in _agentsAll instead of using the dropdown's own value directly, which could null out a valid selection if _agentsAll was ever out of sync. Fixed by awaiting the agent list load before applying the selected value, and by saving the dropdown's own value directly.
